The repository validator reports its own configuration/contracts valid but does not validate this story-state instance; that result cannot cure the invalid evidence records.
findings.correction_outcome: Rerun the two bounded RED states and GREEN restoration with fresh observable evidence. Persist schema-valid unique IDs using the exact <story-key>/implement/<positive-integer> shape, use test-red/test-green or command kinds consistently, and bind each temporary state with the observed source commit plus an exact binary-diff or artifact hash sufficient to identify the uncommitted test/implementation state. Then pin a new clean candidate, refresh every ignored metadata/evidence hash, and rerun the combined quality review before T072. Do not reconstruct unavailable hashes and do not run T072 first.
